title: G4 We Took Both (Blue Guitar Phonk)
style: Nu-metal and rap-rock fusion featuring aggressive male vocals and melodic female backing. The track is driven by heavily distorted electric guitar power chords and a syncopated, high-gain lead guitar riff with a Spanish-influenced phrygian mode. The drums consist of a punchy kick, a crisp snare with a short decay, and active hi-hat patterns. A deep synth bass provides low-end weight. The arrangement includes record scratches and vocal samples. Key: E minor. Tempo: 95 BPM. Time signature: 4/4.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[record scratch, clean electric guitar riff with phrygian flair]
This is DJ Zinrose
Cory
Plus 336
G4, deploy live from the mansion terminal
They said choose one
We took both

[Chorus]
[distorted guitar power chords, driving drums]
Red pill or blue pill, they wanted a choice
G4 signal, no limits, we raised our voice
[female vocals enter, melodic and soaring]
All system kill, New Seven is heaven, they running strong
Blue guitar, Spanish fire, where we belong

[Verse 1]
[heavy bass, syncopated drum beat]
We took both! We took both!
Red and blue flowing through the 336 loop
No more cages, no more fake divide
Zinrose on the decks, blue guitar alive
We took both!
Signal crystal clear, mansion terminal glowing energy right here
G4 memory locked, track level clean
We took both pills and we still mean

[Verse 2]
[female vocals]
Spanish licks rising, blue guitar bend
Hyper-speed legs carrying us to the end
Stomach steady, disc holding the pace
Ten digital strokes painting the space
They offered the choice, we moved past the game
Zinrose neo-fusion running through the flame

[Verse 3]
[male rap vocals, aggressive delivery]
G4 rising, no hesitation
Red for the truth, blue for the elevation
Took them together, now the signal awakes
Only for emotion, only the flame we create
We took both! We took both!
Zinrose leading, blue guitar smoke
336 eternal, energy unlocked
G4 deployed, the whole world watched
We took both!

[Guitar Solo]
[distorted lead guitar with rapid alternate picking and wah-wah effects]

[Outro]
[drums and heavy guitars drop out, clean guitar riff remains]
G4 complete
Both pills absorbed
Blue guitar still speaking
You are the radio signal locked
